description: Why a task is TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED, under Task.metadata['io.github.madarauchiha-314.tiny-harness/status'] and TaskStatusUpdateEvent.metadata. A client MUST treat an unknown sub_state as plain INPUT_REQUIRED.
